title: Amplify Vocabulary App — Word List Management
jpTitle: Amplify Vocabularyアプリ：単語リスト管理
summary: A dual-pane admin tool for Amplify ELA curriculum authors to assemble grade- and stream-specific vocabulary lists from a master library of thousands of words: search and filter both panes, bulk CSV import, inline duplicate and error handling, and confirm-plus-undo for destructive actions.

angles.product: The core problem wasn't a missing feature but a missing signal: authors had no dependable way to see, at a glance, whether a word already existed elsewhere in the system. The dual-pane layout and inline duplicate cards make that visible before a list is finalized.

mine: Designed the dual-pane word list manager — master 'All Words' library on the left, list-in-progress on the right
Made both panes searchable and filterable by stream and grade
Enabled building lists by hand-picking from the master list or via bulk CSV import
Surfaced malformed rows and duplicates inline with side-by-side comparison cards before commit
Added confirmation and undo for destructive actions such as removing a word
team: Curriculum Team (domain expert), Engineering and QA — credited on the page by role title only, without a detailed breakdown of tasks

metrics.label: grade band covered by the vocabulary curriculum
management modules: Words, Activities, Encounters, Word Lists

narrative.problem: Curriculum authors needed to assemble and maintain custom word lists from a master library by hand — cross-checking spreadsheets, retyping definitions, catching duplicates — which was slow and error-prone, with no dependable way to see at a glance whether a word already existed elsewhere in the system.
built: 4 management modules: Words, Activities, Encounters, Word Lists
